scope: Finite GitHub read timeout phase diagnostics in existing broker/adapter and interrupted-read audit; unchanged six-second bound, permissions, token scope, retries and financial controls.
riskAnalysis: STRICT existing authentication and revocation boundary; diagnostics must not leak credentials, trust arbitrary provider properties, weaken fresh owner checks or allow late work to resume dispatch.

threatModel.assets: App signing key, narrowed token, owner authority, immutable audit and source identity.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Trusted broker/adapter to untrusted provider response; private in-memory receipt to existing Ops failure audit.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged diagnostic fields, raw secret errors, unbounded logging, stalled owner/provider, late completion after timeout or revocation.
threatModel.mitigations: Finite enums, at most 64 bounded events, private WeakMap, frozen terminal receipt, unchanged deadline and guards, abort on exit; no retry.

rollback: Revert only reviewed Preview diagnostic delta; preserve all existing App identity, grants, audit evidence, central revocation, main and Production.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Existing bounded parsers unchanged; diagnostics retain only phase and finite HTTP class.
negativePaths.stale-state: Every existing task/source/release/owner check remains required.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing admission CAS and revocation remain unchanged; diagnostic events cannot grant authority.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing cancel signal plus internal deadline abort stop later boundaries; no already-transmitted request recall claimed.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No new worker or execution route; interrupted audit is terminal and existing cleanup revokes grant.
negativePaths.api-outage: Stalled provider or authorization is bounded by unchanged six seconds; phase remains incomplete rather than fabricated success.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Fresh owner and pending grant guards remain before each boundary; diagnostic code cannot bypass them.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No model calls, repository mutations or spending-ledger changes. The existing exact repository-scoped installation-token POST remains necessary and unchanged.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Late completion cannot mutate sealed diagnostic receipt or complete a revoked invocation.

defects.rootCause: Historical timeout audit recorded only overall failure code, leaving the failing boundary unobservable.
defects.detectionGap: Successful substituted transports did not identify cumulative authorization/provider latency or the active phase of a stall.
defects.regression: Actual broker/adapter/Ops timeout audit and late completion tests; malicious provider-property and HTTP-category negatives.
defects.historicalPrevention: The historical timeout itself is not claimed corrected; a future timeout supplies finite phase evidence before selecting a correction.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing GitHub App broker, six-second read adapter, task-bound pending admission and interrupted-read audit; no new authentication or permission system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing App installation/signing-key metadata and durable owner policy. Instrument nine fresh authorization callbacks and four serial GitHub requests before selecting a latency correction.
proactiveReview.threats: Cross-workspace or repository substitution, forged diagnostics, credential reflection, stale task/release authority, cancellation races and late provider continuation.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Installation identity failure prevents token mint; token or repository validation prevents evidence acceptance. Timeout retains the actual active phase without claiming a provider root cause.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual broker/adapter/Ops path with only provider and storage boundaries substituted: installation GET, restricted token POST, repository inventory GET and CI GET; stalled authorization/transport, HTTP classes, revocation, forged diagnostic properties and late completions.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA and Auditor review required before publication, hosted real read remains separately evidenced; no claim of provider permission introspection.
proactiveReview.recovery: Existing interrupted-read CAS revokes the exact grant; no automatic retry, key rotation, permission expansion or authority restoration.
proactiveReview.readiness: Independent QA23 and Auditor source review pass; final source-bound STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL/Preview checks and genuine hosted authentication remain pending.
